provenance.encodes: Piskei Din (Hebrew): פ"ד <volume letters>(<part>) <page>, with the volume in Hebrew numerals
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Israeli Uniform Rules of Legal Citation (הכללים האחידים לאזכור, Israeli law-review style guide) and compare with the Nevo/Takdin rendering of a real judgment.

note: Hebrew volume numerals (e.g. נג = 53). English PD form is foreign.il.pd. A pincite after a comma is in the span, as in foreign.il.pd. Piskei Din (P.D.) reports Supreme Court judgments, so the jurisdiction is foreign.il.sup.
